description: Retrieves values for a specified tag key recorded in a Sentry project. An empty list can also result from a 404 response or a non-list response.

key.description: The specific tag key for which to retrieve the associated distinct values (e.g., 'browser', 'device', 'environment').
key.title: Key

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

project_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry project.
project_id_or_slug.title: Project Id Or Slug

name: retrieve_project_tag_values

tag_values.description: List of unique tag values for the specified key. Returns up to 1000 values. Returns an empty list if the tag key doesn't exist or has no values.
tag_values.title: Tag Values

TagValue.description: A single tag value with metadata.

count.description: Number of times this tag value has been seen
count.title: Count

firstSeen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this tag value was first seen
firstSeen.title: First Seen

key.description: The tag key this value belongs to
key.title: Key

lastSeen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this tag value was last seen
lastSeen.title: Last Seen

name.description: Display name of the tag value
name.title: Name

value.description: The actual value of the tag
value.title: Value

TagValue.title: TagValue
